model_output.campaign_summary: Grandoreiro, a banking trojan active since at least 2016, has resurged with renewed focus on Mexico, Spain, and Latin America after police disruption in 2024. The campaign uses malspam with ZIP attachments impersonating invoices, exploits DLL side-loading via Duplicate Files Finder, and implements sophisticated anti-sandbox/anti-VM evasion to compromise financial sector organizations and exfiltrate credentials. Active infections have been confirmed in Colombia and other LATAM countries, representing a high-risk threat to the regional financial ecosystem.
technique_keywords: masquerading: match legitimate resource name or location [t1036.005]
